title: This Rock Is the Most Venomous Fish on Earth. Spines Punch Through Shoes
subject: stonefish

scenes.text: This rock on the seabed can kill you through your shoe.
It's a stonefish, the most venomous fish known.
It lies still, covered in algae, and looks exactly like coral rubble.
Thirteen dorsal spines each hold two venom glands.
The spines are sharp enough to punch through a shoe.
The pain can last for days. And it never even has to move.

description:
This rock on the seabed can kill you through your shoe.
The stonefish has 13 dorsal spines with venom glands at each base, and the sting can cause paralysis, shock or death.
Have you ever stepped on something in the sea?
first_comment: Would you wade into shallow reef water after this?
